name: Seles
source:
Seles is a fallen angel who was removed from Heaven for gaining too much power and killing God, something the other arch-angels continue to keep a secret. He is sealed within the Abyss, and wants to be free from his prison to create his own utopia, and with the birth of the twin heirs to the thrown of Hell, he just now may have his opportunity..

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/apo/apoa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
